stem:
The chart shows properties of four elements.

Element Properties

| Element | Luster | Conducts Electricity | Conducts Heat | Melting Point |
|---------|--------|---------------------|--------------|--------------|
| 1       | Shiny  | Yes                 | Yes          | Low          |
| 2       | Dull   | No                  | No           | Low          |
| 3       | Shiny  | Yes                 | Yes          | High         |
| 4       | Dull   | Yes                 | Yes          | High         |

Based on these properties, which element is most likely a nonmetal?
visual_elements: table showing Element Properties with columns: Element, Luster, Conducts Electricity, Conducts Heat, Melting Point and rows for elements 1 to 4 with respective properties
